title: 第122章 魏王府的夜（顾赵番外）
slug: 给你尊荣你不要来世我去娶郡主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从转灵寺上下来几日后。

这几日，赵红绫每日皆要殷切叮嘱顾辰珍重身子，顾辰心下纳闷，不知爱妻此番是何用意。

但他每次看赵红绫，都感觉她正在邪邪地笑。

黄昏沉沉，顾怀安把书房内的烛火点上，映得四壁生暖。

顾辰坐在案前，指间捏着好几页薄纸，正是顾怀安的课业。

字迹端正，横平竖直，题解周全，条理分明。

怀安小时候，课业整体是好的，但偶会犯些小错，顾辰也总能挑出些细琐毛病，让他戒骄戒躁。

只不过最近几年，他愈发找不到毛病了。

而最近几个月的课业，从头看到尾，当真是无一处可驳，无一句可改。

他将纸页轻轻放下，抬眼看他，半晌，温声道：“嗯，今天的课业，也很不错。”

顾怀安听后喜上眉梢，每次得到严苛老爹的肯定，他都觉得自己腰杆都直了不少。

他身量已抽条，眉眼间有少年的清俊，也有未褪的稚气。

怀安随后开口：“爹，说好的，如果连着三月课业没有疏漏，是不是后面。”

“往后课业做得快做得好，就可以外出玩耍，也可以读你想读的话本子，但切记不可荒废正事。”顾辰语气平淡。

少年的眼睛骤然亮了起来：“当真？”

“爹几时骗过你。”

顾怀安欢喜得几乎要跳起来，却硬生生压住了，规规矩矩行了一礼：“多谢父亲。”

他转身出门，欢呼雀跃地去翻自己私藏的话本。

顾辰看着儿子远去，心中非常欢喜。

天生目过不忘，正事上沉稳有度，处事不徐不疾，才学更是出类拔萃。

这儿子，当真像极了他。

只是，又不全然像他。

孩子在裴叔叔身上学了几分狡黠，按照裴叔叔的话说就是“此子满腹黑水”，女儿顾怀宁更是对此深表认可。

他又从娘亲赵红绫那里学了几分顽皮，不从正事的时候，他就偏生爱捉弄人。

他和他不一样。

他幼时求而不得的种种，安稳、宽纵、有人护着，怀安都有。

有了更好的教育，怀安的前程，自是不可限量。

至于那性情，顾辰认为，比起自己闷闷的模样，他倒也没觉得怀安这样有什么不好。

-------

王府后园之中，暮色未深。

草木葱茏，枝叶层层叠叠。

赵红绫立于石阶之上，目光落在院中那个红衣少女身上。

顾怀宁，高束马尾，打扮得利落干净。

她手持铁剑，一招一式，虎虎生风。

剑法尚且算不得精纯，可这股子气势，眉眼间的凌厉、出剑时的果决、收招时一甩头的飒爽，已经有了几分她当年的影子。

赵红绫看得出了神。

这女儿，当真是像极了她。

Page (1/3)

A few days after coming down from Zhuanling Temple.

In the past few days, Zhao Hongling had been earnestly telling Gu Chen to take care of himself. Gu Chen was wondering what his beloved wife's intentions were.

But every time he looked at Zhao Hongling, he felt like she was smiling evilly.

As dusk fell, Gu Huaian lit the candles in the study, making the walls warm.

Gu Chen sat in front of the case, holding several pages of tissue paper between his fingers, which were Gu Huaian's homework.

The handwriting is correct, horizontally and vertically, the answers to the questions are comprehensive and well-organized.

When Huai'an was a child, his academic performance was generally good, but he would occasionally make small mistakes, and Gu Chen could always find out some minor mistakes to make him guard against arrogance and impatience.

But in recent years, he has become increasingly unable to find anything wrong with him.

As for the coursework in the past few months, from beginning to end, there is really nothing that can be refuted or a sentence that can be changed.

He put the page down gently, raised his eyes and looked at him. After a while, he said warmly: "Well, today's homework was also very good."

Gu Huaian was overjoyed after hearing this. Every time he received approval from his strict father, he felt that his back straightened a lot.

He has a slim figure, and his face has the handsomeness of a young man, but also has the childishness that has not faded.

Huai'an then said: "Dad, as promised, if there are no omissions in the three months of schoolwork, it will be later."

"In the future, if you do your homework quickly and well, you can go out and play, or read the story books you want to read, but remember not to neglect your business." Gu Chen said in a calm tone.

The young man's eyes suddenly lit up: "Seriously?"

"How often has dad lied to you?"

Gu Huaian was so happy that he almost jumped up, but he suppressed it and bowed politely: "Thank you, father."

He turned around and went out, happily flipping through his private storybook.

Gu Chen watched his son go away, feeling very happy.

He is born with an eye for what he has seen, is calm and measured in matters of business, does things without being slow or hasty, and is outstanding in talent and learning.

This son really looks like him.

But, it's not exactly like him.

The child learned a bit of cunning from Uncle Pei. According to Uncle Pei, "this kid is full of evil", and his daughter Gu Huaining fully recognized this.

He also learned a bit of naughtiness from his mother, Zhao Hongling. When he was not doing business, he loved teasing people.

He is different from him.

He had all the things he had never wanted when he was young: stability, tolerance, protection, and peace of mind.

With a better education, Huai'an's future is limitless.

As for his temperament, Gu Chen thought that compared to his dull appearance, he didn't think there was anything wrong with Huai'an's behavior.

-------

In the back garden of the palace, the dusk was not yet deep.

The vegetation is lush and the branches and leaves are layered on top of each other.

Zhao Hongling stood on the stone steps, her eyes falling on the girl in red in the courtyard.

Gu Huaining had a high ponytail and was neatly dressed.

Holding an iron sword in her hand, she moved like a tiger with every move.

Her swordsmanship is not yet perfect, but her aura, the fierceness in her eyebrows, the decisiveness when she draws the sword, and the sassiness with which she shakes her head when she withdraws her move, already have some shadows of her past.

Zhao Hongling was stunned.

This daughter really looks like her.
